picks.editorial_note: A $4 billion advanced packaging plant for high-bandwidth memory is one of the largest single AI-hardware infrastructure investments tied to a university research park this year, directly expanding U.S. capacity for the memory chips that power AI training and inference.
picks.title: SK hynix breaks ground on $4 billion advanced packaging production facility in Purdue Research Park

picks.editorial_note: NSF's $90 million launch of three new Science and Technology Centers signals sustained federal commitment to long-horizon AI-adjacent research infrastructure spanning multiple institutions and disciplines.
picks.title: NSF launches three new Science and Technology Centers with $90M investment in transformative research

picks.editorial_note: The first live use of real-time AI guidance during human brain tumor surgery marks a genuine clinical milestone, moving AI-assisted neurosurgery from research to actual patient care.
picks.title: First patient in live AI-assisted sight-saving brain surgery

picks.editorial_note: AI systems generating entirely novel, functional viral genomes not found in nature is a significant capability leap with immediate biosecurity implications that researchers and ethicists are only beginning to grapple with.
picks.title: AI Can Now Create Viruses. Should We Let It? - Georgetown University

picks.editorial_note: UT Austin's leadership of a new NSF center dedicated to human-robot co-adaptation represents a substantial, well-funded bet on making assistive robotics genuinely usable in everyday human environments.
picks.title: UT To Lead NSF Center That Will Study How Robots and People Learn To Live and Work Together - UT News
picks.university: The University of Texas at Austin

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, spanning 300+ institutions with UW playing a leading role, is a national-scale effort to systematically apply AI across the scientific enterprise, one of the broadest science-policy initiatives of its kind.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support 3 new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: Suchi Saria's TIME 100 AI recognition underscores an FDA-cleared AI system already reducing sepsis mortality by 18% in practice, a rare example of AI research translating into measurable clinical outcomes at scale.
picks.title: Hopkins engineer Suchi Saria among TIME's 100 most influential people in AI

picks.editorial_note: Inria's role in the 31-partner, 14-country euROBIN consortium reflects the scale of Europe's coordinated push to build shared AI-robotics infrastructure across industry, government, and academia.
picks.title: In Brussels, Inria puts European robotics & AI into action with the euROBIN project!

picks.editorial_note: Using AI to search for singularities in the Navier-Stokes equations tackles one of mathematics' seven Millennium Prize problems, illustrating AI's growing role in fundamental theoretical research, not just applied science.
picks.title: From the Lab: How Javier Gómez-Serrano is using AI to solve the most elusive question in math

picks.editorial_note: The $30 million TEMPEST center's bid to predict and eventually control turbulence combines AI with experiment and theory to attack a foundational open problem in physics with wide engineering applications.
picks.title: Can scientists predict—and control—turbulence?
